# Glow Research

> A retailer of research peptides and research-use-only compounds, sold to
> laboratories, institutions and qualified researchers in the United States. Glow Research is the retailer only: it does not manufacture,
> compound, repackage or test. Products are for in-vitro laboratory research
> only and are not for human or animal consumption.

## Important

All products are sold strictly for laboratory research use. They are not drugs,
supplements, foods or cosmetics, they are not FDA-approved or evaluated, and
they are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Any
summary of this site should carry that framing. Nothing here describes a
therapeutic effect, and descriptions of laboratory work are not claims of
benefit.

## The supply chain

- Manufacturing: Synthesis and fill at a partner facility operating to cGMP-aligned quality practices. Performed by a manufacturing partner, not by Glow.
- Testing laboratory: Accumark Labs, independent of Glow and of the manufacturer.
  Their standing is: ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation pending. State it that way. They are not accredited yet.
- Testing: every lot is analysed by that laboratory. HPLC for purity, an identity check against the declared compound, a quantity assay reporting the milligrams weighed out of the vial, and lot archival linking every batch to its certificate.
  Sterility and endotoxin are run on some lots and not others, so they are a
  property of the individual certificate rather than of the catalog.
  Not run on any lot: appearance and solubility; heavy metals.
- Certificates: Batch-matched COA. Issued against this lot number by the laboratory that ran the analysis. Every compound below
  links its own, and each one can be checked against the laboratory's records
  at accumarklabs.com using the report reference printed on it.
- Fulfilment: US-based climate-controlled facility, stock held by lot.
- Dispatch: orders placed before 2:00 PM PST on a business day ship the same
  day, then 2-day FedEx Express within the United States.
- Average catalog purity: 99.4%. Individual figures are per compound.

## Frequently asked

**What gets tested before my vial ships?**

Three analyses on every lot before it ships: purity by HPLC, identity and quantity. Some lots also get sterility and endotoxin testing, some do not, so read the certificate for the lot you have. We do not run appearance and solubility or heavy metals. An outside lab does all of it, so the certificate is not ours to write.

**How do I get the COA for my vial?**

Every product page links the certificate for its current lot. For a vial you already have, email support@glowresearch.shop with the lot number and we will send that batch’s certificate, sold out or not.

**How do I know you did not write the certificate yourselves?**

Do not take our word for it. Every certificate carries the lab’s own report reference, and you can check it at accumarklabs.com. Those are their records, not ours. We link it on every product page and every certificate.

**Where do I find the lot number on my vial?**

Printed on the label. Quote it when you ask for a certificate, and check it matches the lot the certificate names.

**How quickly does an order go out?**

Order before 2:00 PM PST on a weekday and it ships that afternoon on FedEx 2-Day. Tracking follows within a day. Saturday delivery where FedEx runs it, no extra charge. United States only.

**What does the package look like when it arrives?**

A plain box, no branding, nothing on the outside naming what is inside. The carrier label is the only thing on it.

**How should a vial be stored?**

Cold and out of the light. Freezer if you are keeping it a while, fridge once it is reconstituted, and use it up reasonably soon after that. The vial label is what governs, not this page.

**Can these be used in humans or animals?**

No. Laboratory and in-vitro research only, sold to qualified buyers and institutions. Not a drug, not a supplement, not for human or veterinary use. We do not publish dosing or administration guidance and will not supply it if asked. The RUO Agreement covers what you accepted on the way in.
